hypothesis: Known conjoint-leaf pairs have a common lexical association across metadata-selected homogeneous quire groups outside Q13 that survives the previously fixed nuisance controls.

selection.unit: Two physical leaves sharing IVTFF Q and B; exactly four ordinary recto/verso page records, each containing literal paragraph tokens.
selection.requirements: All four pages must have the same known hand H in 1..5 and the same known Currier L in A/B. Group by quire/hand/Currier; require at least four eligible bifolia. Exclude quire M (Q13).
selection.only_inputs: Mapping, metadata and availability; no edge similarities, forecasts or significance values are used for selection.
selection.excluded: No guessing missing folios, marginalia, mixed/unknown Currier or unknown hand. All excluded mapping groups are archived in replication metadata audit.
selection.timesfm_eligibility: Separate from lexical selection. Whole group's TimesFM diagnostic is BLOCKED if any required page has fewer than four clean rows; no partial-page substitution or horizon retuning.

lexical.representation: Same literal paragraph parser, both comma split and comma join, recto+verso leaf TF-IDF cosine, character trigram and character Jensen-Shannon diagnostics.
lexical.idf: Fit only on leaves outside the entire target quire, including ineligible pairs; do not train on other test leaves of that quire.
lexical.nuisance: Fixed OLS with intercept,char3 cosine,absolute log token-count ratio,squared folio-number gap/100; no pair labels in fit.
lexical.per_group: Enumerate all 105 perfect matchings for eight leaves and all 24 matchings between the four earlier and four later conjoint-leaf sides; include observed. Same per-group strict gates as Q13 retained and reported.
lexical.pooled_statistic: Equal-weight mean of per-group standardized scores: (score - full matching null mean)/full matching null population SD, using that same normalization for full and cross-half nulls. No weights learned from Q13 or observed matching scores.
lexical.pooled_exact_null: Exhaustive independent Cartesian product of the fixed group matching spaces: 105^3=1157625 and 24^3=13824. Save each group's full edge matrices and each matching score; code deterministically reconstructs pooled products rather than storing a million redundant JSON values.
lexical.ties: Inclusive upper tail with tolerance 1e-12; near-zero full-null SD <=1e-12 gives standardized scores zero and p=1, never a positive.
lexical.robustness: For both comma modes, primary and residual observed-minus-full-null-mean must be positive in every group. Recto-only, verso-only and all four leave-one-physical-pair-out primary deviations must be positive against both group reference means.
lexical.panel_rule: PASS_REPLICATION_PANEL iff both comma policies have pooled exact p<=.05 for both primary metrics and both references AND all sign/robustness gates pass. Otherwise FAIL_REPLICATION_PANEL. This new panel cannot retroactively change Q13's FAIL_STRICT_PAIR_COHERENCE.
lexical.scope: Limited selected groups, only four bifolia each. A group pass is not independent confirmation of a global manuscript effect; pooled inference assumes exchangeable pair assignments independently within groups.

timesfm.role: Secondary descriptive check, cannot rescue lexical failure.
timesfm.features: Unchanged ten features and feature_rows cleaning from timesfm_singulion_q13.py.
timesfm.scales: All clean feature rows outside the entire target quire, not merely outside the selected subset.
timesfm.forecasts: One frozen forecast per page, archived with source contexts, targets and directed feature errors; source-only inputs.
timesfm.pair_score: Average of eight directed cross-leaf comparisons; no within-leaf edges.
timesfm.limitations: Model identifier and package version fixed. Upstream weight revision not captured in predecessor; save predictions for exact scoring replay rather than imply immutable future downloads.

claims: No translation, language identification, unique reading order or novelty claim. This is a follow-up on an already studied corpus, not an untouched independent transcription or manuscript holdout.
evidence: Publish metadata selection, protocol before real score computation, code, scientific controls, complete matrices and per-matching scores, exact pooled summaries, GitHub CI result and full evidence audit.
